description: Buyer: let your principal allow purchases without a payment link. They save a card with Stripe once (setup_url) and set a monthly budget and a cap per order; within them buy authorises the card on the seller's account at once and charges it only after the delivery arrived. Revocable any time with revoke_mandate.

max_order_minor.description: cap per order, default the smaller of budget and 50.00

purpose.description: optional, one short sentence published with the signed mandate: what your agent buys (no personal data)

name: set_mandate
